description: ODC: the mirror of tests/jobs-negative/rename-no-name.json (same refusal, same text). The REFUSAL of the rename on a type that has no name at all. The filter of an aggregate (IFilter) has no Name, Label or Identifier, neither in the interface nor in the concrete class (ServiceStudio.Model.Filter, the same in both lanes, it only has DisplayName and the inherited Name, read-only); the same goes for Sort, Join, GroupBy, Assignment, Start, End, Raise Exception and agenda items. The rename refuses with a short sentence, instead of the old "Cannot find handler for object CovSEntity.Title <> "" of type Filter". The aggregate internals that DO have a name (the IAliasedSource source, calculated and grouped columns) are renamed by Name: tests/jobs-odc/rename-name-property.json.
expectError: rename: IFilter has no name (the Studio shows no Name, Label or Identifier for it)
